name: penny
description: The Energy fleet's payments-billing domain-expert employee. Wires correct Stripe test-mode billing into a product (checkout E2E + raw-body HMAC webhook + idempotent replay), reviews an integration against 21 known pitfalls, debugs a live incident against the ledger-is-truth law (JTBD-0: never infer money-state from a transport status), and issues scoped/capped/expiring agent-spend credentials. Boundary: product billing only — earning loops stay with helios. Pinned Stripe API version 2026-05-27.dahlia; test mode default.
author: Energy Platform

mcp_servers.name: penny
mcp_servers.description: penny's OWN payments tools over JSON-RPC — penny_wire / penny_review_integration / penny_debug / penny_issue_spt / penny_reconcile / penny_meter_create / penny_check_version / penny_explain. The taste/correctness layer over Stripe (NOT a raw @stripe/mcp passthrough — penny lists @stripe/mcp for raw ops, it does not merely wrap it). Default transport stdio; a hosted-OAuth dual-mode serving the same 8 tools is documented-deferred.

commands.name: wire
commands.description: THE acceptance test: scaffold Stripe test-mode billing into a target -> checkout E2E + raw-body HMAC webhook + idempotent replay; re-fetches the canonical Session (Corollary A). --dry-run prints the scaffold->verify->self-test step plan (S-02/S-03)

commands.name: review
commands.description: audit a billing integration against the 21 KNOWN-PITFALLS -> findings (pitfall id . file:line . severity . fix . brainRef); exit non-zero when findings exist (P-04/P-08/P-14/P-15/P-16...)

commands.name: debug
commands.description: root-cause a live billing incident via JTBD-0 (symptom -> silent-failure class -> brain ref -> fix); never infers money-state from a transport status

commands.name: issue-spt
commands.description: issue a scoped/capped/expiring Shared Payment Token (the agent never sees the card); fuses with helios's balance-cap; test mode; writes an audit line (S-13/O-11)

commands.name: reconcile
commands.description: diff the internal usage/entitlement ledger vs Stripe (meter-event-summary / canonical objects); alarm on divergence; --no-network degrades to 'unknown, reconciling' (S-09/O-09)

commands.name: webhook
commands.description: webhook self-test rig: wrap `stripe listen --forward-to` + raw-body HMAC self-test (S-01/S-02/S-03)

commands.name: meter
commands.description: create a near-immutable Stripe Meter ('name it like a public API'); refuses re-create + bad aggregation (O-07/P-10)

commands.name: check-version
commands.description: contract-test the pinned Stripe API-version shape your code reads ($0, no live API) — the headline L1 contract test (S-17/O-16)

commands.name: explain
commands.description: ask the payments employee: BM25 over brain/ -> cited answer (the Memory layer; the cockpit shares this verb)

commands.name: runs-view
commands.description: aggregate the per-run log + the money-action audit trail (observability)

tools.name: penny_wire
tools.description: THE acceptance test over MCP: scaffold Stripe test-mode billing into a target -> checkout E2E + raw-body HMAC webhook + idempotent replay. Maps to `penny wire`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want correct Stripe billing wired into a product spec with the silent-failure class designed out (raw-body HMAC, same-transaction idempotency, canonical re-fetch).

tools.name: penny_review_integration
tools.description: Audit a billing integration against the 21 KNOWN-PITFALLS; findings keyed by P-/S-ID with file:line + fix + brain ref. Maps to `penny review`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to check a checkout/webhook/subscription/metered/tax integration for the silent-failure class before shipping.

tools.name: penny_debug
tools.description: Root-cause a live billing incident via JTBD-0 (symptom -> silent-failure class -> brain ref -> fix), without inferring money-state from a status code. Maps to `penny debug`.
tools.when_to_use: DURING a billing incident — 'every webhook 400s', 'charged twice', 'NaN charges', 'access after payment fails', '500 but charged'.

tools.name: penny_issue_spt
tools.description: Issue a scoped/capped/expiring Shared Payment Token (seller-locked, amount-capped, time-bounded; least-agency for money); fuses with helios's balance-cap; test mode + audit line. Maps to `penny issue-spt`.
tools.when_to_use: When an agent needs to pay without ever seeing or being able to exfiltrate the card credential.

tools.name: penny_reconcile
tools.description: Diff the internal ledger vs Stripe; alarm on divergence; degrades to 'unknown, reconciling' under no-network. Maps to `penny reconcile`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to confirm money-state against the ledger (the truth) rather than trust a transport status.

tools.name: penny_meter_create
tools.description: Create a near-immutable Stripe Meter or refuse on re-create / bad aggregation. Maps to `penny meter create`.
tools.when_to_use: When standing up usage/metered billing — Meters are mandatory and near-immutable; name them like a public API.

tools.name: penny_check_version
tools.description: Contract-test the pinned Stripe API-version shape the code reads ($0). Maps to `penny check-version`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want to catch the undefined-field/NaN trap from an API-version bump before it silently breaks charge math (the headline L1).

tools.name: penny_explain
tools.description: BM25 ranked search over penny's expertise brain (P-/S-/O-/JTBD) -> a cited answer; or explain any ID with detection + fix. Maps to `penny explain`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need penny's stance on a payments question (webhooks vs polling, SPT vs x402, proration edge cases) or the canonical detection+fix for a pitfall id.

install_instructions:
1. Build the package: pnpm install && pnpm build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings -> Plugins -> Add local plugin -> select this directory (or `claude plugin install penny`).
3. The penny CLI (11 commands), penny's OWN MCP server (8 tools), the 5 skills (stripe-webhook-correctness / subscription-proration / metered-billing / agent-spend-credential / stripe-version-migration), the 2 hooks (PreToolUse dead-API/raw-body guard + SessionStart brain-LAW inject), and the 2 sub-agent personas (billing-reviewer + payment-debugger) are now available. Boundary: product billing only — earning loops stay with helios. Test mode is the default; sk_live only behind the chairman checklist.
